items.title: What Is Visa (V) Facing After The $38 Billion Swipe Fee Ruling Delay?
items.summary: Visa (NYSE: V) faces renewed legal uncertainty after a US federal judge deferred a ruling on a proposed US$38b swipe fee settlement. The case, involving Visa and Mastercard interchange fees charged to merchants, could proceed to a full trial as late as 2027. The postponed decision keeps open the possibility of major changes to how card transaction fees are structured for US merchants. items.title: What Does Mastercard (MA) Joining The AI Transparency Initiative Mean For Investors?
items.summary: Mastercard (NYSE: MA) has joined Microsoft and more than 40 organizations in a new AI Transparency Initiative. The group plans to create shared standards for transparency, security, and governance of AI systems across multiple industries. The initiative aims to shape how large enterprises validate, monitor, and document AI models used in critical business processes.
